features.brain_discharge: Tap/click hero or orbital brain, or press Enter/Space. Original crystallizer glyphs, faceted pixel shards and extra pulses along six nearby original neural paths; 1.2 second finite effect, up to three concurrent bursts. Cancelled/drifting scroll gestures do not fire.
features.guided_assembly: Starts at zero. Presentation pins below navigation; native scroll drives smootherstep (slow-normal-slow) expansion and all real anchored callouts. A completed 100% view is held before the pin releases. Reverse scrolling reconnects and releases upward.
features.controls: Existing native range seeks the same scroll timeline, including Home/End/arrows. Side labels still focus their layer. No wheel/touch cancellation, scroll snapping or timer-based lock.
features.viewport_fit: Viewport-fitting pinned composition; short-landscape shows concise layer titles with the complete guide outside the pin. Resize rebuild preserves the active story position.
features.continuity: All ten bridges retained; assembly receives and holds the shared crystal throughout its pinned interval, then passes it onward.
features.preserved: Always-on ambient motion, phone-only brain-first layout, desktop/tablet composition, 34 skills, original workbench and contact destinations.

recording.source: Published page in a phone-sized WebKit viewport with touch capability
recording.interactions: Three native touch taps, then native wheel events down and back up

limitations: Not tested on a physical iPhone; no independent flash-safety or motion-accessibility certification claimed.
